en.baseline:
Georgios works across **production ML and LLM systems**, agentic AI, data engineering and evaluation. He is currently a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Kaizen Gaming**.

In his earlier ML Engineer role at the same company, he worked on a multi-agent system that analyzed millions of survey responses and chat transcripts to identify trends and summarize customer experiences. That role also covered Azure Databricks pipelines, FastAPI/NoSQL backend services, and automated testing and evaluation for agentic and LLM systems.

At **EY**, his Senior Data Scientist work included core components of a Business Continuity Platform for an energy company, PySpark pipelines on Azure Databricks, and FastAPI REST APIs. His preceding Data Scientist role included OpenAI/AutoGen assistants for travel, presentation-to-speech and financial analysis, plus RAG pipelines for enterprise LLM applications.

His **CERTH-ITI research** focused on video summarization with encoder-decoder models, attention and transformers. His published projects also include the Workflows to Agents workshop, JPEG image compression, a Unix shell in C, and a Raspberry Pi messenger.

Would you like to explore the customer-feedback system or his video summarization research?

Ο ρόλος περιλάμβανε επίσης pipelines στο Azure Databricks, υπηρεσίες FastAPI/NoSQL και αυτοματοποιημένες δοκιμές και αξιολόγηση για agents και LLM.

Στην **EY**, ως Senior Data Scientist, δούλεψε σε βασικά τμήματα πλατφόρμας επιχειρησιακής συνέχειας για εταιρεία ενέργειας, pipelines PySpark/Databricks και REST APIs με FastAPI. Στον προηγούμενο ρόλο του ως Data Scientist, ανέπτυξε βοηθούς με OpenAI/AutoGen για ταξιδιωτική υποστήριξη, μετατροπή παρουσιάσεων σε ομιλία και οικονομική ανάλυση, καθώς και RAG pipelines.

Η έρευνά του στο **CERTH-ITI** αφορά περίληψη βίντεο με encoder-decoder μοντέλα, προσοχή και transformers. Στα έργα του υπάρχουν ακόμη το workshop για workflows και agents, συμπίεση JPEG, Unix shell σε C και εφαρμογή μηνυμάτων σε Raspberry Pi.

en.baseline:
**From Workflows to Agents** was a hands-on workshop at TechSaloniki X in May 2026. A support-ticket assistant provided the running example: a plain LLM call grew into structured outputs, tool calls, a fixed workflow and a bounded agent loop. Evaluation ran through the demo, using golden datasets and an optional LLM-as-a-judge step. The point was choosing the autonomy the application needs. The slides are linked below.

![Workshop overview: workflows, agents and evaluation](/projects/from-workflows-to-agents/featured.webp)

Would you like to explore how the workflow and agent differ?
en.fun:
**From Workflows to Agents** takes a support-ticket assistant beyond a single prompt, without declaring every extra loop a technological revolution. The TechSaloniki X workshop adds structured outputs, tools, a fixed workflow and a bounded agent, then checks what actually helped. Golden datasets and an optional LLM judge keep the demo accountable. Autonomy has to earn its place. The agent brings an impressive CV; the tests still handle recruitment. The slides are below.

![Workshop overview: workflows, agents and evaluation](/projects/from-workflows-to-agents/featured.webp)

Want to compare the workflow with the agent?
en.race-engineer:
Copy. **Support-ticket assistant, controlled build-up.** First run: one LLM call. Then structured outputs, tool calls, a fixed workflow and a bounded agent loop. Evaluation checks run throughout, with golden datasets and an optional LLM judge. The call from this TechSaloniki X workshop: use only the autonomy the task needs. Watch point: flexibility also adds variability, cost and latency. Slides are below.

![Workshop overview: workflows, agents and evaluation](/projects/from-workflows-to-agents/featured.webp)

Shall we debrief the workflow-versus-agent decision?
en.formal:
**From Workflows to Agents: Building LLM Systems in Practice** was a practical workshop at TechSaloniki X in May 2026. Using a support-ticket assistant, it compared a basic LLM call, structured outputs, tool use, deterministic workflows and bounded agent execution. Evaluation included golden-dataset checks and an optional LLM-as-a-judge stage. Its central distinction was between predictable execution paths and tasks whose next step depends on intermediate findings. Presentation slides are available below.

![Workshop overview: workflows, agents and evaluation](/projects/from-workflows-to-agents/featured.webp)

Would you like a closer comparison of workflows and agents?
en.concise: **From Workflows to Agents** uses a support-ticket assistant to compare LLM calls, tools, fixed workflows and bounded agents. Golden-dataset checks help evaluate whether each addition improves the system; the slides are linked below. Would you like to compare workflows and agents?

el.concise: Το **From Workflows to Agents** συγκρίνει απλές κλήσεις LLM, εργαλεία, προκαθορισμένες ροές και agents με όριο βημάτων, μέσα από έναν βοηθό υποστήριξης. Οι έλεγχοι αξιολόγησης δείχνουν τι προσφέρει κάθε προσθήκη, ενώ οι διαφάνειες είναι παρακάτω. Να δούμε πότε χρειάζεται agent;

en.baseline:
The site presents **three coauthored papers on video summarization**: global and local attention with positional encoding for supervised summarization (ISM 2021); concentrated attention with frame uniqueness and diversity for unsupervised summarization (ICMR 2022); and attention-based explanations of which video fragments influence a summary (ISM 2022). Together, they address both selecting useful video content and understanding the model’s choices. The primary PDFs are linked below.

Which would you like to explore: the summarization methods or their explanations?
en.fun:
The site features **three coauthored papers about getting to the useful parts of a video**, then asking the model to explain its choices. ISM 2021 combines global/local attention and frame position. ICMR 2022 uses concentrated attention plus frame uniqueness and diversity without supervision. ISM 2022 examines which fragments influence the summary. A research program for anyone who has ever thought, “Surely this video could have been shorter.” The PDFs are below.

Methods first, or what the model paid attention to?
en.race-engineer:
Debrief: **three coauthored video-summarization papers**. ISM 2021: supervised summarization with global/local attention and positional encoding. ICMR 2022: unsupervised summarization using concentrated attention, uniqueness and diversity. ISM 2022: explanations of which fragments influence the summary. Different runs: build the summary, then inspect the decision. Primary PDFs are below.

Which run shall we examine: summarization or explanation?
en.formal:
The website presents **three coauthored publications on video summarization**. The ISM 2021 paper combines global and local attention with positional encoding for supervised summarization. The ICMR 2022 paper investigates concentrated attention, frame uniqueness and diversity in an unsupervised setting. The ISM 2022 paper examines attention-based explanations of the fragments influencing a summary. The primary papers are available in PDF form below.

en.concise: The site features **three coauthored video-summarization papers**: global/local attention and positional encoding (ISM 2021), concentrated attention with frame uniqueness/diversity (ICMR 2022), and attention-based explanations (ISM 2022). Η ISM 2021 συνδυάζει καθολική και τοπική προσοχή με τη θέση των καρέ. Η ICMR 2022 αξιοποιεί συγκεντρωμένη προσοχή, μοναδικότητα και ποικιλομορφία χωρίς επίβλεψη. el.formal:
Η ενότητα **Formula 1** περιλαμβάνει ανασκοπήσεις σεζόν με γραφήματα, πρακτικό [οδηγό κατανόησης αγώνων](/el/formula/racecraft/) και [αρχείο πρωταθλητών οδηγών και κατασκευαστών](/el/formula/champions/). Ο οδηγός καλύπτει το αγωνιστικό τριήμερο, τα ελαστικά, τις σημαίες και τη στρατηγική. Τα άρθρα προσφέρουν ιστορική ανάλυση επιμέρους σεζόν.

Θα προτιμούσατε να εξετάσουμε τη στρατηγική ή την ιστορία των πρωταθλημάτων;
el.concise: Θα βρείτε **ανασκοπήσεις σεζόν και γραφήματα**, [οδηγό αγώνα](/el/formula/racecraft/) για ελαστικά, σημαίες και στρατηγική, καθώς και [αρχείο πρωταθλητών οδηγών και κατασκευαστών](/el/formula/champions/). Από πού θέλετε να ξεκινήσουμε: στρατηγική ή ιστορία;

en.alt: Max Verstappen celebrates the 2023 Formula 1 title

el.alt: Ο Max Verstappen πανηγυρίζει τον τίτλο της Formula 1 του 2023
